prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, high-contrast low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette, textured brushwork and physically tactile surfaces, legible silhouette at 200 pixels. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon lines, energy ribbons, floating runes, or unsupported anatomy.
ANATOMY: VIRACOCHA, Andean supreme creator in an original human-appearing BEARDED male form, two human arms/hands and two legs, long opaque woven dark gold/crimson robe. An immense antique-gold CROWN WITH SUN RAYS fully inside image, ray crown broader than head. Hold ONE thunderbolt in EACH hand, both distinct hands readable, no staff in this variant. Tears streak his face in the storm, referring to iconographic tears representing rain. Beard and human form c02, hand thunderbolts and solar ray crown c19; natural Andean brown skin is editorial, do not use unsupported European white-god portrayal. [viracocha-c02/c19] MOMENT: Raise and extend both thunderbolt-bearing arms toward the storm, bend into a forceful forward step out of the dark gateway; stare downward at viewer with immense sovereign calm, not an ordinary standing man. POWER: actual forked lightning connects the hand-held thunderbolts to thunderclouds, rain lashes the gateway and water splashes under his feet; sun/storm sovereignty c22 and thunderbolts/tears c19, no extra colored energy ribbons or halo. SCALE & CAMERA: extreme worm-eye full figure fills 90 percent of square, ray crown and two lightning hands clearly readable; gateway pillars peripheral, apparent divine monumentality by tight perspective. LIGHT & WEATHER: a single lightning flash is dominant source, warm antique-gold reflected accents, black storm darkness, forceful rain. SURFACE: wet rough woven robe, carved gold rays, beard heavy with rain, weathered stone. SETTING: alive sacred rendering before the massive Tiwanaku gateway, not a sculpture. [viracocha-c19] MOOD: overwhelming respectful divine creator, awe not monstrous villain.

visual_requirements.description: Human-appearing bearded creator; A alive interpretation of Tiwanaku iconography with two hand-held thunderbolts and ray crown, B old man in long robe supported by staff.
A physically commands storm/lightning/rain, B rises from dark Lake Titicaca as dawn sun brings light.
Tiwanaku gateway/Lake Titicaca creation setting; architecture detail editorial, main god alive rather than statue.

selection_reason: Proposed selected: solar-ray crown, both hand-held thunderbolts and active storm make creator identity most immediately imposing.

visual_review.notes: Native viewed: bearded human-appearing brown-skinned creator takes a forceful forward step from gateway in opaque heavy woven robe; two hands each hold a distinct gold zigzag thunderbolt with actual sky lightning, wide solar-ray crown above. Rain/wet cheek streaks and splashing stone, imposing low view. One head/two arms, no extra limbs, text, gore or generic aura.
limitations: Topmost crown ray ends slightly clipped by upper edge; broad radial crown shape remains clear.
Geometric textile/metal ornaments and gateway details are editorial, not readable letters.
A beard/human form is c02 and Tiwanaku crown/bolts c19; staff is only alternative B.
